user-security.title: Security
user-security.description: Manage two-factor authentication and your sign-in password. Every request is proxied by the BFF to the auth service, and credentials never reach browser storage.
user-security.loginRequiredHint: Security settings need an active session; you will be returned here after signing in.
user-security.mfaHint: Register the secret below in any authenticator app; sign-in then also requires a 6-digit code.
user-security.mfaBindWarn: Rebinding invalidates the current one-time codes immediately, so already paired authenticators can no longer sign in. Continue?
user-security.mfaCopyFailed: Copy failed, select the text manually
user-security.mfaUriHint: The link lives in page memory only and dies on reload; the secret is shown exactly once.
user-security.mfaCodeInvalid: Wrong one-time code, check the authenticator clock and retry
user-security.passwordHint: The current session stays valid; if the upstream revokes tokens afterwards, the next request refreshes automatically.
user-security.newPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, mix case and symbols
user-security.newPasswordSame: The new password must differ from the current one
user-security.confirmPasswordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
